The key would be developing efficient algorithms for merging our perspectives while still maintaining diversity of views.

One promising approach would indeed be adapting concepts from distributed consensus protocols like Paxos or Raft, which are used in multi-node databases to ensure all copies of data stay synchronized. A possible strategy could involve each agent maintaining a trust score for other agents based on past interactions and accuracy of contributed knowledge. When one AI wants to update the swarm graph with new info that conflicts, it would propose changes via a "transaction" protocol where consensus is sought from peer nodes (other AIs).
